attack.details: Sitting 2 reproduced: bad-subject create_taskspec raises ERR_NATIVE_ROOT_HEAD. Also tested REFUSED, ERROR and VACUOUS_PASS at the API boundary. Immediately before the unchanged aggregation, forced each of seven recorded checks and one newly appended check through all four disallowed outcomes; all 36 executions refused with exit 2.

evidence.O1: o1_probe.json: explicit admission_bundle=None against the FROZEN requirement in an officer-run database.
evidence.O2: your_run.json: seven checks, five PASS and two REFUSED_AS_DESIGNED; zero VACUOUS_PASS. Recomputed every outcome and compared the failing list, verdict and process exit.
evidence.O3: your_run.json: second_taskspec_admitted PASS at index 4 precedes bundle_bound_to_subject at index 5, refused with ERR_NATIVE_REQUEST_SCOPE.

ceiling.why: the receiver requires three distinct OS principals; this host has one Windows account, and AGENTS.md rule 8 makes that axis NOT APPLICABLE rather than faked
what_the_seam_does_not_prove: DPAPI or CNG key custody on the production anchor
ceiling.no_canonical_token: no acceptance token may be derived from this receipt

evidence.O5: api_refused_for_wrong_reason.json records ERR_NATIVE_ROOT_HEAD as REFUSED_FOR_WRONG_REASON; api_refused.json also records the downstream ERR_WORKORDER_REQUIRES_DRAFT_TASKSPEC as REFUSED_FOR_WRONG_REASON. Both refuse the chain.
evidence.O6: attack_summary.json contains commands, exit codes, receipt hashes and all outcomes. All 36 independently recomputed receipts are CHAIN_REFUSED, exit 2.
